Everything in this section is read from the source.
`tests/unit/test-exports.typ` holds `lib.typ` to a list of public names, so an accidental export cannot slip in, though nothing yet checks that list against these pages.

Keisen has no release yet, so import `lib.typ` from a clone rather than from Typst Universe.
Everything a document needs comes out of that one file, the nanoplot renderers included, because a Typst package specification cannot carry a subpath: `@preview/keisen:0.1.0/src/...` is not valid syntax, so a module reachable only from a clone would be reachable by nobody who installs the package.

## The pages

- [Entry point](display-table.qmd) for `display-table` and the three selectors every directive takes.
- [Table parts](table-parts.qmd) for the header, the stub, row groups, spanners, notes, styles, and options.
- [Columns](columns.qmd) for labelling, aligning, sizing, hiding, moving, and combining columns.
- [Formatters](formatters.qmd) for turning a value into the notation it is read in.
- [Nanoplots](nanoplots.qmd) for the in-cell renderers and the domain they share.
- [Locations](locations.qmd) for addressing cells by what the data says.
- [Aggregations](aggregations.qmd) for summary rows and the functions that fill them.
- [Themes and options](themes.qmd) for the four presets and every option key.
- [Serialised specifications](serialised.qmd) for reaching the pipeline from another language.
- [Figures and Quarto](figures.qmd) for wrapping a table in a float.

## Limitations

- Summary rows require groups, from `table-stub(group: ..)` or from `table-row-group`; use `grand-summary-rows` for a table without them. Rows outside every declared group are summarised by the grand summary alone.
- Neither a nanoplot column nor a combined column can be summarised: a series of readings has nothing to aggregate, and a combined column holds content rather than quantities. Naming either in `summary-rows` is an error rather than a blank cell.
- A combined column is opaque, so it is not decimal-aligned and infers start alignment.
